sentimento.text1: The presidential book holds USD 148.77M and the prices on this page come from the confirmed reading of 12/Sep, 1:10 PM BRT (4:10 PM UTC). 📉 THE GAP IN THE WINNER CONTRACT CLOSED 10.00pp IN ONE DAY: Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 49.95% (vol USD 10.47M accumulated) and Lula at 48.50% (vol USD 10.81M), against 53.95% and 42.50% in the confirmed reading of 11/Sep. That is 4.00pp down for one and 6.00pp up for the other, and the distance between them went from 11.45pp to 1.45pp. ⚠️ THE MOVE CANCELS AND REVERSES THAT OF THE TWO PREVIOUS DAYS, when the gap had widened from 6.25pp to 9.35pp and then to 11.45pp. The 49.95% sits 5.15pp below Flávio's series peak, of 55.10% on 10/Sep, and Lula's 48.50% sits 19.00pp below his own peak, of 67.50% on 16/Aug. Neither price is an extreme of the series, and neither is the gap: over 566 points since 14/Apr, it has reached 41.80pp in Lula's favour on 01/Aug and 14.30pp in Flávio's favour on 11/Sep.
sentimento.text2: 🥉 IN THE THIRD-PLACE CONTRACT FOR THE FIRST ROUND the favourite widened his lead: Augusto Cury rose 2.90pp, to 55.80% (vol USD 173 thousand), and Renan Santos fell 1.50pp, to 37.00% (vol USD 299 thousand). The gap went from 14.40pp to 18.80pp. Ronaldo Caiado rose 3.00pp in that same contract and stands at 8.00%. 🏛️ THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 GAVE BACK 1.60pp and stands at 6.70% (vol USD 90 thousand), undoing part of the 11/Sep rise. 🗳️ In the Senate majority contract Partido Liberal rose 1.00pp and stands at 84.00% (vol USD 261 thousand), with MDB at 9.40%. 📌 The second-place contract for the first round publishes no new price in this round.
sentimento.text3: ⭐ THE POLL THAT ENTERS TODAY IS THE DATAFOLHA OF 11/Sep, AND IT BREAKS A RUN OF EIGHT. Fieldwork from 08 to 10/Sep, 2,002 interviews, a margin of 2.0pp and 95% confidence, TSE registration BR-01833/2026. In the first round Lula has 39% and Flávio Bolsonaro 35%, with Augusto Cury at 6%, Ronaldo Caiado at 4%, Renan Santos at 3% and Romeu Zema at 2%. In the runoff pairing Lula comes out ahead by 46% to 44%. 📌 THERE HAD BEEN EIGHT STRAIGHT NATIONAL POLLS SINCE 06/Sep IN WHICH LULA DID NOT COME OUT AHEAD IN THE PAIRING AGAINST FLÁVIO BOLSONARO, and this is the first in which he does again. ⚠️ The 2-point difference fits inside a margin of 2.0, so what the house measures is a TECHNICAL TIE and not a lead, and the same holds for the 4 points of the first round, which fit inside two margins. 🔁 AND THE COMPARISON INSIDE THE HOUSE ITSELF SHOWS STILLNESS: Datafolha also measured 46% to 44% on 03/Sep, exactly the same pairing, and 47% to 43% on 21/Aug. That is three rounds in which the pairing travelled 1 point on each side. 🗳️ In the other four pairings tested Lula wins them all: 45% to 43% against Cury, 46% to 41% against Caiado, 48% to 39% against Zema and 48% to 37% against Renan Santos.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 49.95% in the winner contract, down 4.00pp and 5.15pp below his series peak, of 55.10% on 10/Sep. In the Datafolha of 11/Sep he has 35% in the first round and 44% in the runoff pairing against Lula, a 2-point difference that fits inside the margin of 2.0. At the same house, on 03/Sep, he had 44% in the pairing, and on 21/Aug he had 43%. Ronaldo Caiado stands at 0.15% in the winner contract, rose 3.00pp in the third-place contract for the first round, to 8.00%, and has 4% in the first round of the Datafolha.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 48.50% in the winner contract, up 6.00pp, the largest rise of any contract on the panel in this round, and 19.00pp below his series peak, of 67.50% on 16/Aug. In the Datafolha of 11/Sep he has 39% in the first round and 46% in the runoff pairing, and it is the first national poll since 06/Sep in which he comes out ahead in the pairing again. He wins the five pairings tested by the house, and in three of them the distance falls outside the margin. Fernando Haddad remains at 0.05% in the winner contract, with USD 7.53M accumulated.
sentimento.terceiraVia: Augusto Cury is the favourite in the third-place contract for the first round, with 55.80% and a rise of 2.90pp, and has 6% in the first round of the Datafolha of 11/Sep. Renan Santos fell 1.50pp in that same contract, to 37.00%, and has 3% in the poll, but his contract still holds USD 13.32M accumulated, the second largest individual volume in the book, behind only that of Tarcísio de Freitas, with USD 14.07M. Romeu Zema records 2% in the first round and loses the runoff pairing to Lula by 48% to 39%, outside the margin.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of 12/Sep, 1:10 PM BRT (4:10 PM UTC). ⭐ In this round FOUR of the five watched contracts received a new price: winner, third place in the first round, Supreme Court impeachment and Senate majority. The second-place contract for the first round publishes no new price on 12/Sep. AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, and the confirmation is made contract by contract.

inss.text1: 📌 THERE IS NO INSS ACT AT THE SUPREME COURT ON 12/Sep. What there is, is a request in Congress: deputy Lindbergh Farias filed a motion to investigate senator Flávio Bolsonaro over an alleged link to the operator named in the INSS fraud case (Poder360, 12/Sep). A request to investigate is not an open investigation, and the page records the difference.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: Fachin's refusal of the joint trial, on 12/Sep, concerns the Master case and not the INSS. The page does not join the two cases. What links them is the institution in the middle, not the object of the investigation.
inss.impactoLula: The structured reading of government approval remains the Genial/Quaest of 07/Sep, with fieldwork from 03 to 06/Sep: 43% approve and 50% disapprove. There was no new approval round on 10/Sep, and the panel keeps one pollster per block on purpose, so that the internal series does not mix.
inss.impactoGestao: Within Quaest itself the picture stopped being one of stillness. On 05/Aug it was 48% approval against 47% disapproval, on 14/Aug 46% against 48%, and on 07/Sep 43% against 50%. That is 5 points of decline in approval and 3 points of rise in disapproval in about a month, measured by the same pollster with the same design.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the topic is narrow: there is no INSS act at the Supreme Court on 12/Sep, there is a motion filed in Congress, and the government's rating still comes from the 02/Sep reading. The day's movement is in the market, which closed a 10.00pp gap, and in the Court's procedure.

bancoMaster.text1: 🔴 THE ACT OF 12/Sep IS FACHIN'S REFUSAL OF THE JOINT TRIAL. The president of the Supreme Court denied Alexandre de Moraes's request to try in a single session the cases involving Moraes himself and André Mendonça, kept the session of 15/Sep and scheduled a second session for 23/Sep (Poder360 and Gazeta do Povo, outlets independent of each other, both on 12/Sep). In the filing, Moraes argued there was a risk of contradictory decisions and procedural disorder. 📌 The two sources disagree on what exactly enters the 23/Sep session, and for that reason this page records the scheduling of the date and not its object.
bancoMaster.text2: 📅 THE CHRONOLOGY THE RECORD SUPPORTS, and it has three distinct days: on the night of 10/Sep, at 11:44 PM, André Mendonça granted a request by Edson Fachin and lifted the secrecy on 14 proceedings in the Master case; on 11/Sep the content became public, and it was through it that it became known that senator Flávio Bolsonaro has been under Federal Police investigation SINCE JULY 2026, authorised by Mendonça himself, for money laundering, currency evasion and corruption in the financing of the film Dark Horse; still on 11/Sep, Fachin gave 24 hours for the release of the rest and Moraes accused him of selective choice; and on 12/Sep came the refusal of the joint trial. ⚠️ The investigation did not begin on any of those days: what changed on 11/Sep is that it stopped being secret.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The price on this page comes from the 1:10 PM BRT reading of 12/Sep. In that reading, the winner contract of the person under investigation fell 4.00pp, after rising 1.10pp the day before, and the gap to the runner-up closed 10.00pp. AFOS records the order of events and does not attribute cause to the price, because the book is arbitraged continuously and no single reading separates one motive from another.
bancoMaster.conclusao: What changes from 11 to 12/Sep is not the content of the case, it is the procedure. On 11/Sep the Court was debating how much of the secrecy would fall; on 12/Sep it debates who tries what and when. A record under judicial seal and a public record are different states of the SAME fact, and the distinction of dates matters: the investigation into the senator has been running since July, became public on 11/Sep, and the trial calendar is set on 12/Sep.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act on 12/Sep. He remains a target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos, together with Alexandre de Moraes.
stf.moraes: 🔴 NEW ACT ON 12/Sep: Fachin denied his request for a unified trial of the cases involving him and André Mendonça, which he had filed arguing a risk of contradictory decisions. The session that examines the request to investigate him remains scheduled for 15/Sep. On 11/Sep he had already accused Mendonça of selective choice in releasing the secrecy and pressed Fachin for a full release.
stf.gilmar: 🔴 NEW ACT ON 12/Sep: he asked Fachin for access to the full copy of the media extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's mobile phone, reinforcing a request Cristiano Zanin had already made, on the eve of the 15/Sep session (Gazeta do Povo, Folha de S.Paulo, O Globo, G1, Estadão and VEJA, all on 12/Sep).
stf.dino: No new individual act on 12/Sep. On 10/Sep he authorised the Federal Police operation into the financing of the film Dark Horse and ordered precautionary measures against Mario Frias, and on 09/Sep he had reversed the removal of the Federal Police leadership.
stf.mendonca: No new individual act on 12/Sep. On the night of 10/Sep he lifted the secrecy on 14 proceedings in the Master case at Fachin's request, and on 11/Sep he released additional documents after a new order, keeping part under seal, which Moraes contested.
stf.nexo: The link to the election is one of calendar and of institution, not of outcome. In three days the secrecy on 14 proceedings fell, the content made public that one of the candidates has been under investigation since July, and the president of the Court determined that the two justices involved will be tried in separate sessions, one on 15/Sep and another on 23/Sep. The first of them falls less than a month before the first round.
stf.analise: 🏛️ THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 GAVE BACK: it stands at 6.70% (vol USD 90 thousand), confirmed reading of 12/Sep, 1:10 PM BRT, against 8.30% in the confirmed reading of 11/Sep, a fall of 1.60pp. 📈 It remains 19.40pp below the peak of the series, of 26.10% recorded on 11/Sep at 5:00 AM BRT, and 4.60pp above the floor, of 2.10% on 08/Jun. In other words, the book gave back part of the previous day's jump. ⚠️ The accumulated volume, USD 90 thousand, is small enough that isolated orders can move the price, and that caveat holds in both directions: it held when it rose and it holds now that it has fallen. 📌 The move happens on the day Fachin denied the joint trial of Moraes and Mendonça and scheduled separate sessions for 15 and 23/Sep. AFOS records the coincidence of dates and does not attribute cause.
stf.fachin: 🔴 NEW ACT ON 12/Sep: he denied Moraes's request for a unified trial with Mendonça, kept the session of 15/Sep and scheduled a second session for 23/Sep (Poder360 and Gazeta do Povo, on 12/Sep). On 11/Sep he had given Mendonça 24 hours to release the remaining documents, granting a request by the Prosecutor General's Office.
